title: Chunk ships a mechanically corrupted scripts/static-check.py: broken shebang, dropped exec bit, mangled comments
evidence: chunk hunk: "-#!/usr/bin/env python3" / "+#!/ usr / bin / env python3"; header: "old mode 100755 / new mode 100644"; HEAD blob line 1 reads exactly: '#!/ usr / bin / env python3'; comment damage: '+# 5. CRLF scan on tracked text files(best - effort : git tracked only)' and '+#sim never reads a clock).bUseFixedFrameRate must be False so the view'
detail: Unintended collateral damage (space-injecting automated edit), not asked for by any spec. Gate 3 survives only because local-ci invokes it via 'python3 scripts/static-check.py'; direct ./scripts/static-check.py execution now fails on the bad shebang.
recommended_fix: Restore '#!/usr/bin/env python3', chmod 755, and re-indent the mangled comments (the uncommitted r3 overlay already does exactly this — land it).

title: static-check now enforces bUseFixedFrameRate=False while the canon docs it contradicts (AGENTS.md, architecture-ue-v1.md) were left pinning True
evidence: chunk: '+    check(ini_kv.get("/Script/Engine.Engine.bUseFixedFrameRate", "").lower() == "false",' / '+        "bUseFixedFrameRate must be False (UAD-2: the sim rate is the driver accumulator's; the render runs at display rate)")' — vs docs/architecture-ue-v1.md:376-377: '**Decision.** `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` pins `bUseFixedFrameRate=true; FixedFrameRate=20.0` (already committed).' and AGENTS.md:55: 'the sim steps at 20 Hz (ODN-2; `bUseFixedFrameRate` is pinned in `Config/DefaultEngine.ini`)'
detail: The flip itself is the deliberate, proven r2 fix (r2 acceptance finding: easing structurally unreachable under the True pin) and matches stories-ue-v1.md's '20 Hz sim → 60 fps view'. But the reviewed canon surfaces were not updated in this PR — an agent following them re-pins True and re-breaks story 1.2.
recommended_fix: In the same PR, update architecture-ue-v1.md's UAD-2 decision and AGENTS.md's fixed-tick line to record the r2 ruling (driver-owned 20 Hz, display-rate render).

title: verify-capture-geometry.py is delivered as 'the capture-pipeline geometry gate' but nothing wires it into any pipeline — it never runs
evidence: docstring: '"""scripts/verify-capture-geometry.py — the capture-pipeline geometry gate.' / 'Verifies a committed T2 frame's geometry (Perkins r2: "add an / endpoint-vs-node-center geometric check to the capture pipeline").' — while grep -rn 'verify-capture' across scripts/, docs/, bin/, .mcp.json finds only the file's own usage/line-51 self-reference, and docs/agent-playbook.md's capture flow (lines 65, 76) lists only 'editor.capture_screenshot' with no geometry step.
detail: The r2 fix asked for the geometric check IN the capture pipeline. The checker exists (and runs — PIL present) but no gate, playbook step, or script invokes it, so rendered-frame regressions (the road-anchor class of bug) ship unchecked unless run from memory.
recommended_fix: Wire it in: add the playbook capture step 'python3 scripts/verify-capture-geometry.py <frame>' after editor.capture_screenshot, and/or a fast-gate over the committed docs/goldens/screens frames.
